mapper.update: UPDATE wa_group wa_group INNER JOIN group_link_preview preview ON preview.tenant_id = wa_group.tenant_id AND preview.group_jid = wa_group.group_jid SET wa_group.display_name = CASE WHEN #{row.displayNameObserved} THEN #{row.displayName} ELSE wa_group.display_name END, wa_group.remark = CASE WHEN #{row.remarkObserved} THEN #{row.remark} ELSE wa_group.remark END, wa_group.avatar_url = CASE WHEN #{row.avatarObserved} THEN #{row.avatarUrl} ELSE wa_group.avatar_url END, wa_group.deleted_at = NULL, wa_group.updated_at = GREATEST(wa_group.updated_at, #{row.updatedAt}) WHERE wa_group.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND preview.group_link_id = #{row.groupLinkId}

UPDATE wa_group_invite invite INNER JOIN group_link_preview preview ON preview.tenant_id = invite.tenant_id AND preview.invite_code = invite.invite_code SET invite.display_name = CASE WHEN #{row.displayNameObserved} THEN #{row.displayName} ELSE invite.display_name END, invite.remark = CASE WHEN #{row.remarkObserved} THEN #{row.remark} ELSE invite.remark END, invite.avatar_url = CASE WHEN #{row.avatarObserved} THEN #{row.avatarUrl} ELSE invite.avatar_url END, invite.deleted_at = NULL, invite.updated_at = GREATEST(invite.updated_at, #{row.updatedAt}) WHERE invite.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND invite.group_id IS NULL AND preview.group_link_id = #{row.groupLinkId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wa_group resolved_group WHERE resolved_group.tenant_id = invite.tenant_id AND resolved_group.group_jid = preview.group_jid )

#{groupLinkId}
